Can a US court summon India’s National Security Advisor Ajit Doval through an Indian court? In this video, we explain the Gurpatwant Singh Pannun case, why a New York judge has sought help from Delhi’s Patiala House Court, and how India’s laws, sovereignty and diplomatic immunity could shape the next chapter of this legal battle.
